verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Containers product that runs "code written in any programming language, built for any runtime, as part of apps built on Workers," and the Sandbox SDK is "Built on Containers" with a full Linux environment per container. This shows first-party container execution tied to Workers. However, the evidence never mentions Docker images, Dockerfiles, or a container deploy workflow. Missing for 10: explicit Docker image/Dockerfile packaging support, a documented container deploy command or workflow (e.g. via Wrangler), container limits and lifecycle details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers

citations.quote: Run code written in any programming language, built for any runtime, as part of apps built on Workers.
